status: frozen proposed cases awaiting lead review

cases.name: All status pairs and causes
cases.oracle: Parametrize all 10×10 ordered pairs for each supported cause against an independently declared expected allowed-pair set; invalid guards must refuse without mutation.

cases.name: Every review destination
cases.oracle: Each of the ten In Review targets succeeds with correct decision/evidence; each missing decision, destination evidence or startup guard refuses.

cases.name: Initial queue order
cases.oracle: No direct new Todo or Backlog start; Backlog acknowledgement precedes explicit Todo acknowledgement; duplicate enqueue is idempotent.

cases.name: Delivered work
cases.oracle: Attempt reserve/start/resume on In Dev/In Staging/Done fails; linked follow-up must use separate approved prose and Backlog.

cases.name: Human precedence
cases.oracle: An automation call using an older human decision revision cannot undo a later hold/assignment; approved release permits only intended operation.

cases.name: Non-code and terminal exits
cases.oracle: Only verified no-code completion reaches Done without deployment; cancel requires reason/quiescence; duplicate additionally requires canonical link.

cases.name: Scope and capability
cases.oracle: Cross-principal/project/session handles, forged tokens, revoked tokens and missing bindings cannot read/mutate/observe task or event data.

cases.name: Atomic reservations
cases.oracle: Two independent SQLite connections race same task and global/project cap boundaries; at most one active attempt and no capacity oversubscription.

cases.name: Expected versions
cases.oracle: Stale task versions and stale decision revisions refuse before any task/attempt/event/outbox partial write.

cases.name: Idempotency
cases.oracle: Same operation+scope+payload returns original outcome once; changed payload or foreign scope cannot reuse an operation identity.

cases.name: Prose gate
cases.oracle: Reject absent receipt, stale writer/reference/style version, changed title/body/code literal, wrong representation and fake reviewed=True input.

cases.name: Provider representation
cases.oracle: A trusted fixture renderer may apply only the declared bullet/tight-list encoding before approval; exact canonical approval succeeds while wording/code changes fail.

cases.name: Startup truth
cases.oracle: Reserved and Starting do not imply Running; trusted worker identity plus matching In Progress acknowledgement are required before a work lease is granted.

cases.name: Failure retention
cases.oracle: Failed/timeout/unknown attempts persist independently; restart retains reserved/uncertain ownership until confirmed recovery.

cases.name: Checkpoint history
cases.oracle: Checkpoint/progress updates retain attempt identity and do not themselves establish liveness, success, merge or deployment.

cases.name: Transactional obligations
cases.oracle: A forced failure after tentative task mutation rolls back task, event, outbox and notification; successful change creates each once.

cases.name: Notification receipts
cases.oracle: No receipt can skip queued→delivered→AI-ack→user-reported; proof must match event, target session and stage; invalid proof changes nothing.

cases.name: Session cursors
cases.oracle: Two sessions sharing one project do not consume one another events/cursors; another principal cannot read or acknowledge them.

cases.name: Durable outbound
cases.oracle: Outbox claim leases serialize adapters; uncertain/failing operations remain durable and retry does not fabricate confirmation or lose history.

cases.name: Inbound dedup
cases.oracle: Same provider delivery ID+payload is idempotent; reused ID with different payload is a conflict; durable ingress is distinct from applied policy state.

cases.name: Schema/restart
cases.oracle: File-backed store can reopen with schema version checks, preserved history and explicit refusal of unsupported future schema; no destructive reset.

cases.name: Independent package boundaries
cases.oracle: Imports use only standard library/domain/storage/application boundaries; no build-control, provider, UI, legacy synchronizer or source skill imports.

cases.name: Intent before remote side effects
cases.oracle: Submit/create and explicit queue intent are durably recorded before any adapter request. Until trusted Backlog/Todo readback, later admission is refused. Crash/restart retains pending intake/outbox without fabricating a provider issue or repeating an uncertain create.
